scope: Float32 seam guard experiments and shared precise Split regression on one original scan face.

test.result: Shared runScanEdit precise Split yields two connected components with positive oriented facets, no nonmanifold edges, conserved signed projected area to 10 decimal places, and unchanged inputs.
limitations: One source face and cutter; signed area can hide compensating gaps and overlaps.
This is a shared operation test, not a new rendered GUI or public MCP replay or native result comparison.

discardedGuards: Per-edge relative displacement at 1e-6 rejected the existing original-scan face control.
Per-refined-face displacement area at 1e-4 also rejected that control. Both experiments were removed; a threshold adjustment alone is not established as correct.
limitations: The Float32 seam coverage expected failure and three native Split facet expected failures remain.
No application behavior, MCP schema or production implementation changed.
